title: Etale cohomology of one geometric point
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and let $C=\operatorname{Spec}k$. For an abelian etale sheaf $F$ on $C_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with its unique geometric point $\bar c$ and geometric stalk $F_{\bar c}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], the etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] satisfies $H^q(C,F)=0$ for every $q>0$, and the canonical map $H^0(C,F)\to F_{\bar c}$ is an isomorphism.
